info.title: Continu Reporting API
info.description:
Read-only reporting API for the Continu platform. Pull learning, engagement, assignment, and assessment data into your warehouse, BI, or downstream systems.

**Auth.** Send your API token in the `Authorization` header with a `Bearer` prefix (e.g. `Authorization: Bearer <your-token>`). Tokens have a 30-day TTL and no refresh endpoint — on expiry, request a new token (an Admin can generate one from the Developer Tools area of your Continu instance).

**Date ranges.** Path-level `{from}/{until}` parameters are Unix epoch seconds in UTC.

**Request bodies.** Each POST body is a field-selection document: set field flags to `true` to include them in the response, and provide filter objects to narrow results.

**Rate limits.** 50 requests per minute and 5,000 requests per day, both per company across all tokens/integrations. Configurable per-customer on request.

post.description: Returns one record per content item with full metadata (id, title, type, published, created_at, tags, in_track_title, archived, views, likes, ratings, etc.). Works as both an engagement report and a published-content catalog — content records are returned regardless of whether anyone has engaged with them.

BearerAuth.description: Send as `Bearer <token>`. Tokens have a 30-day TTL with no refresh endpoint; on expiry you'll receive a 401 with message body `"invalid token TTL Expired, unauthorized request"` — request a new token (an Admin can generate one from the Developer Tools area of your Continu instance).
